meta.name: inf
meta.author: CamoGekko
meta.description:
Turns Mindustry into a truly [red[]]hostile[white[]] environment.

Remotely good blocks are nerfed into [red[]]oblivion[white[]], automation is restricted,
and old schematics are made useless through mechanical changes.

Expect broken habits, slower progression, and constant pressure.
This mod exists to make processing and survival genuinely [red[]]infuriating[white[]].
